story.title: Dream Adventure
story.summary: Your child and Tiny the elephant are best buddies. One morning Tiny is gone, so your child goes looking through their dreams: the sea, the jungle, and the moon.

slot.label: The child
slot.description: A child about 1 to 12 years old, the main character on every page
slot.outfit: a red-and-white striped long-sleeved top and red trousers

styleWords: thin, slightly grainy pencil outline and soft watercolour colouring
